title: Data Allowances, Fair Usage Policy (FUP), and Speed Throttling
summary: Rules governing mobile and broadband data quotas, high-usage throttling triggers, and on-demand data top-up bolt-ons.

sections.heading: Fixed Broadband Unlimited Guarantee
sections.text: All NexusTel residential Fiber broadband plans (Fiber 100, 500, Gigabit Pro) are truly unlimited with zero monthly data caps and no artificial traffic throttling or peak-hour shaping.

sections.heading: Mobile Data Throttling & Allowances
sections.text: On Ultra Mobile 50GB, reaching 100% of the 50GB domestic quota reduces speeds to 128 kbps for the remainder of the billing cycle unless a data bolt-on is added. 5G Unlimited Mobile is subject to a 1000GB Fair Usage Policy threshold for residential non-commercial usage.

sections.heading: On-Demand Data Bolt-Ons
sections.text: Customers on capped mobile plans can instantly purchase supplemental high-speed data: 10GB Data Pass for $10.00 or 25GB Data Pass for $20.00 via the mobile app or SMS reply 'DATA10' to 60070.
